title.narrative: Renewable Lesotho: Access to Affordable and Renewable Energy

description.narrative:
Renewable Lesotho will contribute to a green and resilient economy by promoting energy security, access to reliable and affordable clean energy, and green growth. Renewable Lesotho has three specific objectives:

1. Increase renewable energy generation production and energy efficiency;

2.Promote a more reliable, equitable and gender-transformative access to clean energy;

Improve Lesotho¿s energy sector leadership and institutional capacity.
